title: Lavish Aerated Ukrainian Monsoon Borscht Soup
description: A savory, aerated Ukrainian dish featuring Chinese sesame sauce and dashi-extract, perfect for monsoon weather. This recipe is kosher-friendly and ideal for dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Kosher chicken broth
ingredients.notes: +1 cup water for dilution before serving

instructions: In a large pot, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated beetroot, carrot, and celeriac to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the dashi-extract, kosher chicken broth, and 1 cup of water to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Strain the soup through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add 2 tablespoons of Chinese sesame sauce and 1/4 cup of sesame oil to the pot, stirring to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with chopped fresh dill and a dollop of Chinese sesame sauce, if desired.
Serve hot, finishing with a drizzle of sesame oil and a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
